# AlarmBanner

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

List of active alarms with time, source, priority and message (SCADA-006, SCADA-007).

!!! danger "Not a safety-related system"
    The alarms shown here may be delayed, lost or stale. It is for visualization, teaching, simulation and supervision; it is not a safety-related system and must not perform a safety function. See the [safety notice](../safety.md).

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[520,180]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | derived | Alarms that are not back to normal, {id, timestamp, source, priority, message, state}; the view sorts them (unacknowledged first, then priority and time). Written by the host (Python: raise_alarm(), clear_alarm()); without a host owning the state, the front end applies the acknowledgements (an alarm back to normal leaves the list) and writes the list back (HOST-004, HOST-012). |
